title: Practice 1: при- and у-: arriving, and leaving

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **приводил** — past tense (masculine) of приводить: imperfective (perfective partner: привести).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: The dog ran away from us.
exercises.why: **убежала** — past tense (feminine) of убежать: perfective (imperfective partner: убегать).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
